objective: Add durable MongoDB workspace persistence and an immutable context edit ledger beneath the canonical ContextFabric working-context boundary without introducing a new authority or database.

rulesConsidered: MongoDB is the canonical distributed operational persistence boundary.
ContextFabric is the sole active working-context authority.
Durable persistence must not become policy, capability, economic, artifact, verification, or release authority.
Stale writers must fail closed rather than overwrite newer state.
No new database or parallel context authority is introduced.
All non-trivial changes pass the Team Change Gate.

changes: Added typed ContextConcurrencyConflictError for stale workspace writes.
Added MongoContextFabricRepository using context_workspaces and context_edit_ledger collections.
Made edit ledger insertion idempotent by editId.
Registered the persistence repository in DatabaseFactory.

verificationResults.note: Fresh validation required on the exact PR head. Mongo live proof is environment-dependent and must remain UNPROVEN until a real Mongo instance verifies round-trip and concurrency behavior.
